in_marathi.name: Amoditha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amoditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'amoda', meaning 'joy'. The name 'Amoditha' signifies a state of immeasurable happiness and bliss. It is believed to bring immense joy and contentment to the bearer.
